title: Nob-MIAs: Non-biased Membership Inference Attacks Assessment on Large Language Models with Ex-Post Dataset Construction

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) distance to compare the n-gram overlap distributions of candidate member and non-member sets with respect to a reference set of left-out members.

Restricting the selection of both member and non-member documents to a specific historical publication timeframe (e.g., books published between 1850 and 1910) to prevent the models from relying on chronological metadata or evolving vocabulary.

Training LLM-agnostic classifiers (e.g., a Bayes algorithm on multinomially distributed 1- to 3-grams) to distinguish between members and non-members, and evaluating the bias by measuring the classifiers' Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC) and True Positive Rates.

primary_bias_target: Distributional dataset bias in Membership Inference Attacks
